responsibility: Low-level process, pipe, exec, wait, and polling support for GNAT.Expect. It provides the host-dependent C implementations behind expect-style subprocess control—fork/exec or spawn, pipe creation, waitpid status retrieval, and readiness polling over child output channels—with separate Unix, Windows, VMS, and stub variants. This file is specifically the transport/process substrate for the Expect library, not the broader OS abstraction layer in adaint.c.
